english.title: Fail to comply with notice in writing to surrender revoked document / card - Vehicle Drivers (CPC) Reg's 07

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Vehicle Drivers Certificates of Professional Competence Regulations 2007

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with a notice in writing issued by the Secretary of State requiring the surrender forthwith of

(A)_[an NVT certificate]_
(B)_[a driver qualification card issued under regulation 8A, 8AA or 8AB namely, **(..SPECIFY REGULATION..)]_
(C)_[a national driver qualification card issued under regulation 8AC or 8AD namely, **(..SPECIFY REGULATION..)]_

of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007, it appearing to that authority that it had been granted

(D)_[in error]_
(E)_[with an error or omission in the particulars specified]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(2), (3) and (9) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.

english.notes:
(i) These regulations apply to persons driving a bus on or after 10th September 2008 or driving a lorry on or after 10th September 2009.
(ii) See regulation 3(2) for vehicles to which these regulations DO NOT apply.
(iii) This offence applies from the 3rd December 2024 due to SI 2024/1160.
